title: Evidence history · request failures, model repairs & author-added range check
scope: One pre-request refusal, one timed-out Ultra request, then two separate Super repair runs with two and three proposals. The closed-range variant was added by the author after the first repair passed. Final browser checks reuse the model component without new inference. This is not one six-round autonomous repair or a blind evaluation.
sourceNote: Public Pikaday issue #955, pinned original JS/CSS and an author-created weekday-booking consumer. The author added the closed-range variant after reviewing the first patch. Original requests, rejected proposals and verdicts remain unchanged.

steps.title: Frozen reproduction using the original component
steps.kind: Author-created consumer; unmodified pinned upstream component
steps.description: ArrowRight from Friday 23 October selected closed Saturday 24 October. Pointer selection of an available weekday passed. The backward task was fixed before inference, omitted from the model task requirements, with its source markup visible.

links.label: Inspect original failure and pre-request refusal

steps.title: The unchanged pipeline stops before inference
steps.description: The original model-context limit rejected the dense calendar evidence. This result is INCONCLUSIVE, with no browser candidate and no model request.

steps.title: Author fixes generic model-context preparation
steps.kind: Human implementation change; source and tasks unchanged
steps.description: Repeated DOM HTML is removed from the bounded control inventory while concrete failing checks and complete allowlisted source are retained. Keyboard guidance is task-neutral. No date-specific repair rule was added.

steps.title: Ultra request times out
steps.kind: Provider request attempted; no response recorded
steps.description: The request exceeded its two-minute deadline. Its usage is unknown and its budget reservation was retained. It remains INCONCLUSIVE and is not a successful model execution.

steps.title: Super repairs weekday navigation
steps.kind: Real uncached model run; two proposals
steps.description: Attempt 1 was rejected for invalid response fields before browser verification. Attempt 2 changed Pikaday’s date arithmetic and passed forward keyboard and independent pointer selection. The unchanged component also passed the precommitted backward task. A later range probe found a remaining flaw.

steps.title: Author adds a closed upper-bound variant after the pass
steps.kind: Post-hoc human scenario; not a blind test
steps.description: The author configured a pickup maxDate on closed Saturday 24 October. The first repaired component still selected Saturday instead of preserving Friday. Only consumer configuration/text changed; the component remained byte-identical to the first model candidate.

probe.kind: Post-hoc author review probe; no inference
probe.condition: Last available day is Friday Oct23; maxDate is closed Saturday Oct24. ArrowRight must preserve Friday.

steps.title: A separate model run fixes the closed boundary
steps.kind: Real uncached model follow-up; three proposals
steps.description: Attempt 1 failed JavaScript syntax checking; attempt 2 failed exact patch application; neither reached browser verification. Attempt 3 fixed the component’s boundary handling and passed both gates. Already-working reverse and pointer paths were preserved.

steps.title: Final same component passes both original directions
steps.kind: Fresh-browser rechecks; no new inference or human repair code
steps.description: The author copied the final model component into the original consumer. Forward and backward tasks, each with independent pointer selection, passed. The downloadable patch is cumulative against the original component. Post-hoc review also checked closed minimum/maximum dates, no later availability, a custom weekday closure and a month boundary.

patchReview.method: Installed Chrome, clean headless profiles; post-hoc targeted model-patch review probes, no inference.

steps.title: Independent review: ArrowDown loses a day in London
steps.kind: Reviewer probe and post-hoc task; no inference
steps.description: The runner now accepts a declared browser time zone. In Europe/London, ArrowDown from Friday 23 October 2026 selected Thursday 29 October because Pikaday adds 24-hour blocks across the end of British Summer Time. The defect is in the pinned upstream component and survived the earlier model patches. UTC, London and closed-range checks were frozen as withheld checks.

steps.title: Ultra proposals rejected before the browser
steps.kind: Real uncached model run; two proposals
steps.description: Both proposals rewrote a line inside the region they were replacing, so the preimage did not match the source and nothing was applied. A third request was stopped by the local token ceiling before any call.

steps.title: Super switches to calendar-day arithmetic
steps.kind: Real uncached model run; two proposals
steps.description: Attempt 1 was truncated during reasoning. Attempt 2 replaced millisecond offsets with setDate in both the jump and the closed-day skip. Withheld UTC forward/backward, London forward/backward and closed-range checks passed as full runs, and London ArrowUp stayed correct. Review note: parseInt was removed, which is safe for the component's numeric keyboard calls but would change string arguments passed to the public adjustDate method.
